newsitem.title: USA: Home Health files for 3.6 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: Home Health files for 3.6 mln share offer.

text.p: Home Health Corp of America Inc said late Friday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of 3,623,500 shares of common stock.
That number excludes the underwriters' over-allotment option, the company said in a statement issued after trading closed in New York.
The offering consists of three million newly issued shares of common stock with the remainder to be sold by existing shareholders.
The company, which provides nursing and other home health services, will use the proceeds to repay bank debt and a portion of the cash consideration for certain pending acquisitions.
Underwriters for the offering include Dean Witter Reynolds Inc., Volpe, Welty & Co and Wheat First Butcher Singer.
